solutions.title: Counting map
solutions.strategy: Count every value and return once a count crosses half the array length.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map stores one counter per distinct value.

solutions.title: Boyer-Moore vote
solutions.strategy: Cancel different values against the current candidate until the guaranteed majority remains.

timeComplexity.explanation: The voting pass visits each element once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the candidate and vote count are stored.
